absent: Exact numeric values and bit positions of area flags, advice behaviours, error codes and marker encodings.
Contracts of fault helpers, userfault removal, filesystem fallocate, page walk variants, anonymous preparation, huge-page helpers, deduplication helpers and flag update helpers.
Locking and lifetime rules for area write begin, flag reset, protection derivation, writenotify prediction and softleaf conversion.
How the guard retry bound is chosen and how userspace restart resumes the caller.
Contents of willneed, cold, pageout, dontneed and free, collapse, anon naming and collapse handling beyond dispatch.
Failure modes of fast user page lookup, failure injection, poison page acquisition, poison filtering and large page splitting.
Translation gathering, cache maintenance and huge trans checks beyond the call sites shown.
Creation and lifetime of userfault contexts and address spaces outside release and attach.

findings.text: Provides a helper that recomputes cached page protection for an address range descriptor, honouring shared writenotify adjustments and publishing the result for lock-free readers.
Provides a helper that discards page table mappings over an address interval inside one area, gathering and finishing translation shootdown around the batched invalidation.
Provides an operation that attempts to withdraw a physical frame number from service, returning distinct status for invalid, offline, disabled, filtered, busy and success outcomes.
Provides a helper that detaches a compound memory unit from its current management and queues it on a caller list, handling dedicated large-page, movable-operation and reclaim paths.
When a userfault monitor context is torn down, every address area in the owning address space whose stored monitor reference equals that context is detached, leaving other areas untouched.

Attaching or clearing a userfault monitor on one area replaces the stored context, clears prior userfault tracking bits from area flags before merging requested bits, and refreshes cached protection when the write-protect tracking bit changed on a shared area.

Cached protection for an area is derived from area attributes, with a second derivation that drops the shared attribute when writenotify is wanted; the final value is published in a way safe for readers without the address space lock.

Populate advice prefaults a caller interval in chunks, advancing by successfully faulted pages, reacquiring the read lock if the fault helper dropped it, and translating helper failures into interruption, invalid, poisoned, fault or shortage results with a one-time warning for unexpected codes.

Remove advice only applies to a file backed shared writable mapping that is not locked; it computes a file offset from area start plus page offset, notifies userfault handling, punches a hole preserving size, then reacquires the read lock and returns the filesystem result.
Guard eligibility rejects areas marked special or huge, and optionally rejects locked areas, allowing locked areas only for the non-destructive removal direction.

Guard installation marks the area as possibly guarded, ensures an anonymous control object exists for anonymous areas, then repeatedly attempts to place guard markers; any populated or huge encounter triggers invalidation of the interval before retry, with bounded retries after which control returns to userspace for a fresh attempt.

During guard installation, upper level huge entries and populated leaf entries signal that invalidation is required, while an existing guard marker is counted as already done and otherwise a fresh guard marker is installed and counted.
Guard removal walks only the target area and clears leaf guard markers with cache maintenance, while huge upper entries are treated as absence of guards and skipped; locked areas are accepted.

A fixed subset of advice behaviours is classified as discarding, covering memory release, need hints, removal, fork disposition controls and guard installation, while all other behaviours are non-discarding.

When sealing is enabled, unsealed areas accept any advice, sealed areas accept non-discarding advice and any file backed discarding advice, and sealed anonymous discarding advice is accepted only if the area remains writable as permitted by architecture checks; otherwise permission is denied.
When sealing support is disabled the sealed predicate is always false and the permission check always succeeds.

The per-area advice dispatcher first enforces the sealing permission, then routes removal, need and reclaim hints, collapse, and guard install or remove to dedicated handlers, while access pattern, fork, dump, naming, deduplication and huge-page hints update area flags or delegate to specialised helpers before a common flag-update path that maps shortage to retryable shortage.

Access pattern hints mutually exclude sequential and random behaviour, fork and dump hints set or clear persistence attributes with rejection for special, shared file, droppable or huge combinations, and anonymous naming is rejected for non-anonymous file mappings.

Error injection advice requires administrative privilege and iterates the interval page by page using fast user page lookup, sizing steps by compound page size, invoking soft offlining for the soft offline behaviour and simulated failure injection otherwise, treating unsupported failure injection as success.

Soft offlining validates the frame number, requires an online page, honours a global enable switch, and treats an already poisoned page as success; otherwise it holds a dedicated mutex, attempts to grab the page for offlining, applies a filter that can veto with unsupported status, then either migrates an in-use page or poisons a free or huge page with at most one retry on race.

Poison handling optionally dissolves huge or free pages first, then marks hardware poison, adjusts reference counts to pin the poisoned state, and accounts the event in a global poisoned counter keyed by frame number.

Offlining an in-use page splits accessible large non-huge folios only when the target split order is zero, waits for writeback, rechecks for concurrent poisoning, attempts cache eviction for clean reclaimable file content with immediate poisoning on success, otherwise isolates and migrates the unit before poisoning the original, reporting busy on split, isolation or migration failure.

Isolation to a caller list uses a dedicated huge-page path, a movable-operations path with unevictable isolation, or the reclaim path with accounting as isolated anonymous or file, finally linking the unit onto the list on success.
Release of a userfault context holds the address space write lock across a full area iteration while resetting matching areas, ensuring no concurrent area flag mutation.

Remove advice marks the lock as dropped, releases the read lock across userfault notification and filesystem hole punching while holding a file reference, then reacquires the read lock before returning.

Guard installation sets a maybe-guarded area flag atomically under read lock, prepares anonymous state that expects read lock when needed, and drives page walks with a lock mode derived from the caller mode, retrying with invalidation that assumes appropriate walking safeguards.
Flag-updating advice paths are write operations that require the address space write lock at the common update point.
Soft offlining serialises with a dedicated failure mutex and brackets page acquisition with online-memory references to stabilise hotplug state.
Offlining an in-use page holds the folio lock across poison recheck and eviction preparation, waiting for writeback on non-huge units before proceeding.

An address area descriptor exposes flags, cached protection, a userfault context slot, file backing, start address, owning address space and anonymous state, all consulted by protection, userfault and advice paths.
Advice execution state carries the target address space, current area, numeric behaviour, address interval with start and end, lock mode and a flag recording whether the lock was dropped.

Page walk configuration for guard work supplies callbacks for upper and leaf levels plus a leaf installer and a walk lock selector, with private storage used as a counter of installed or observed guard pages.

Guard installation cycles through walk, success return when counted pages match expected span, otherwise invalidate and retry, exiting with error on walk failure or userspace restart after exhausting bounded attempts.
Populate advice loops while start trails end, faulting the remainder, advancing start by faulted pages times page size, and returning zero only when the whole interval is covered.
Soft offlining for a free page attempts poisoning once, and on failure due to race clears the counted-reference adjustment and retries acquisition a single time before reporting busy.
Per-area advice handling is the central dispatch that validates sealing permission and routes each numeric behaviour to its handler or flag-update path.
Guard install and remove handlers and populate, remove and error-injection handlers each serve as behaviour-specific entry points invoked with prepared advice state.
Concurrent faults or background huge-page activity can repopulate a guard interval between walk and install, requiring invalidation and bounded retry to avoid lost guards or live mappings.
Dropping the address space lock during hole punching allows area teardown, so a file reference must be held across the unlocked filesystem call to keep the backing object alive.
Failure to split, isolate or migrate an in-use soft-offline target must return busy without poisoning, and partially migrated lists must be returned to reclaimable state to avoid leaking isolation.

Advice behaviours include MADV_NORMAL and MADV_RANDOM and MADV_SEQUENTIAL with MADV_DONTFORK and MADV_DOFORK and MADV_KEEPONFORK and MADV_WIPEONFORK with MADV_DONTDUMP and MADV_DODUMP with MADV_FREE and MADV_DONTNEED_LOCKED and MADV_DONTNEED with MADV_REMOVE and MADV_GUARD_INSTALL and MADV_GUARD_REMOVE with MADV_WILLNEED and MADV_COLD and MADV_PAGEOUT and MADV_COLLAPSE with MADV_MERGEABLE and MADV_UNMERGEABLE with MADV_HUGEPAGE and MADV_NOHUGEPAGE with MADV_POPULATE_WRITE and MADV_SOFT_OFFLINE.

Advice and offlining report EINTR and EINVAL and EHWPOISON and EFAULT and ENOMEM mapped to EAGAIN with EACCES and EPERM and EBADF with EBUSY and EIO and ENXIO and EOPNOTSUPP depending on the failure class.

Area flag bits include VM_LOCKED with VM_SPECIAL with VM_HUGETLB with VM_SHARED with VM_WRITE with VM_SEALED with VM_SEQ_READ with VM_RAND_READ with VM_DONTCOPY with VM_WIPEONFORK with VM_DONTDUMP with VM_DROPPABLE with VM_UFFD_WP and its mask, plus the guard marker concept and VMA_MAYBE_GUARD_BIT.

Filesystem removal uses FALLOC_FL_PUNCH_HOLE with FALLOC_FL_KEEP_SIZE, injection requires CAP_SYS_ADMIN, and offlining uses MF_COUNT_INCREASED with MF_SOFT_OFFLINE with MF_ACTION_REQUIRED with MF_SW_SIMULATED.
